tagline: Technology and digital-solution profile prepared for business matching.

story.title: Technology and digital-solution profile prepared for business matching.
story.body: GiGa Tech tercatat dalam handover sebagai penyedia inovasi perangkat lunak/perangkat keras. Detail produk, spesifikasi dan kontak bisnis tidak diinventarisasi sebelum sumber primer tersedia.

highlights.title: Business problem first
highlights.body: Technology positioning is framed around buyer discovery, not generic innovation slogans.

highlights.title: Claim discipline
highlights.body: No fabricated client counts, stack claims or product specifications.

highlights.title: Direct route
highlights.body: Public channels can be added without changing the page architecture.

verification.note: No sufficiently specific public result was found that safely matches the TEI tenant GiGa Tech in Tangerang Selatan.
